source_executable.source: Korean Test Build Actions artifact 11373183170 / run 37379204466

inherited_proof_from_b205.native_input: legacy one-byte selector table; not UTF-8/UTF-16

consumer_classification.consequence: The committed native field is handed directly to stock text-object construction; Korean display needs an explicit player-name render path rather than assuming the Text-ID overlay will see it.

evidence: 0x4B2A43 copies 6 bytes from 0x7C23E0 through memcpy-like 0x449A60, then 0x4B2A61 forces NUL at destination+4.
0x4B2BBE, 0x4B2C60 and 0x4B2D0C pass 0x7C23E0 to NUL-aware bounded copy 0x581780 with count=4.
consumer_classification.consequence: UTF-8 can be truncated on byte boundaries and can split a Hangul code point; direct native-field UTF-8 is unsafe.

evidence: 0x491900 copies exactly the requested bytes into its writer buffer
consumer_classification.consequence: The native representation is serialized as raw bytes with no Unicode transcoding.

evidence: 0x467641 pushes count 0x17 and 0x46764B calls memcpy-like 0x449A60 into a global/session record.
consumer_classification.consequence: At least one wider record embeds the player-save prefix byte-for-byte; changing the native field affects non-render consumers.

evidence: src/hooks_localization.cpp RememberText records only valid translated text IDs.
ResolveTextId succeeds only for remembered pointer/content mappings.
InterceptPrint exits when ResolveTextId fails and only hooks stock printf paths.
consumer_classification.consequence: The existing K4 UTF-8 overlay is not a generic arbitrary-player-name codec/render path.

evidence: SumoNet_OnlineUserName remains a distinct buffer at EXE+0x430C20 / VA 0x830C20.
B205 found no proven data-flow link making it identical to the license-name field.
consumer_classification.consequence: Do not claim Korean license-name transport works online merely because the chat/lobby identity buffer is narrow-char.

policy_decision.cp949_or_high_bit_native_field: NOT_PROVEN_SAFE; stock one-byte/high-bit rendering and fixed-byte consumers remain blockers
policy_decision.compatible_direction: Keep native 16-byte field as an ASCII-safe <=15-byte compatibility alias; store canonical Korean UTF-8 in mod-owned sidecar state; add explicit local player-name render hooks. Keep online/remote transport on the compatibility alias until a separate protocol/transport path is proven.
policy_decision.why_no_runtime_patch_this_run: Consumer mapping proves what must not be done, but exact sidecar lifecycle and all local display callsites are not yet sufficiently mapped for a fail-safe behavior change.

next_safe_work: Map the exact name render/use callsites that must substitute sidecar Korean text locally.
Choose a stable sidecar key and save/load lifecycle for License.dat/LicenseXX.dat slots.
Define a deterministic ASCII compatibility alias/token policy within 15 bytes.
Only after those are proven, implement runtime name-entry/render behavior and run Win32 Release validation.
Treat online/remote Korean-name transport as a separate future proof; alias fallback is mandatory until then.
